requirements.basis: Net usable energy 3.6213 MWh plus 0.0724 MWh fixed 1 h auxiliary gives 3.6937 MWh gross. To still deliver 2.300 MWh the window must stay at least 64.2% of 80%. That leaves 28.6% of SOC to lose, split over both window ends, so 14.3% each.
Cell safety limit: disconnect within 150 ms above 3.75 V. The chain is 3 confirming scans plus one missed scan (about 61 ms), one 10 ms MCU cycle and the 30 ms contactor opening, about 101 ms.
8 s DC-bus-ready limit minus the 1 s start sequence. The resistor must also limit peak current to 30 A (R >= 1343.2/30 = 44.8 ohm) and absorb 0.5*4.8 mF*1343.2^2 = 4.33 kJ.
Self-discharge spread of 1.66%/month at 35 C of 220.9 Ah is 3.67 Ah. Balancing for 8 h/day over 30 days is 240 h, so 3.67 Ah / 240 h = 15.3 mA.

Above about 6.9x of the 400 A FU-10 (about 2760 A) the fuse pre-arcing time is shorter than the cell short-time limit, so the fuse protects alone. Below that the contactor must interrupt, and the sensor range must reach the contactor breaking capability.

The double fault sequence keeps voltage below 70% from t=0 to 0.7 s + 1.529 s = 2.229 s (70% is reached 1.529 s after the final breaker opening). Subtracting the 20 ms supply hold-up leaves 2.209 s to be bridged.

Transformerless PCS units on a shared ungrounded winding form one galvanically connected IT system. Its leakage capacitance is 19*1.67 + 4*10 + 19*2*80 m*0.23 nF/m = 31.73 + 40 + 0.70 = 72.4 uF, so one plant IMD is used.
